independentLayers.description: Reference numbers for the offset, arrow, card padding, radius, gap and width cap.

intent: Preview where a link goes (a profile, a page, a document) while the pointer rests on the link or it has keyboard focus

properties.description: Whether the card is shown. Setting it (attribute or property) fires no openchange; hover, focus, Escape or an outside press set it unless openchange is canceled.
Open at first connect when no open attribute is present (Base UI defaultOpen).
Never opens; presses, hover and focus on the trigger do nothing.

Preferred side of the trigger (Base UI Positioner side): top, bottom, left or right; empty for the default (bottom). The popup flips to the opposite side when there is no room; data-side says where it is.
Alignment along that side (Base UI Positioner align): start, center or end; empty for the default (center).
Open after the pointer rests this long on the link, in ms (Base UI delay); default 600. Keyboard focus opens it at once.
Close this long after the pointer leaves link and card, in ms (Base UI closeDelay); default 300, time to move onto the card.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Sets the unit u (px) for this element and its subtree: one of the SIZES steps 2…12 (data-size is the same input). Lengths scale from u; type follows 10px + u.

attributes.name: gap
attributes.description: Gap between the card's children in u (0…8 in 0.5 steps); default the collection gap (2u).

events.name: openchange
events.trigger: hover intent, keyboard focus, focus leaving link and card, an outside press or Escape opens or closes the card; preventDefault keeps it as it is

semantics.role: none on the host; the trigger is the author's link; the card has no role (Base UI Preview Card) and is not announced on its own

keyboard.action: show the card; Tab again moves into it
follow the link (the card does not toggle)

sources: the link's own text; the card repeats what the destination shows

content.children: The trigger link (the first child element), then the card's content (any elements); or authored [data-part=trigger] and [data-part=popup] children. A [data-part=arrow] draws the arrow.

constraints: The card is supplementary: everything in it must also be reachable at the link's destination (touch has no hover).
The host takes no box (display: contents): the link stays inline in its text.
Setting open from script shows or hides the card without an openchange event.

avoidWhen.when: A short label for a control.
avoidWhen.reason: A tooltip is the compact text label; a preview card is a rich card for links.

avoidWhen.when: Content opened by a press, with actions or inputs.
avoidWhen.reason: A popover opens on a press and takes focus; a preview card opens on hover and focus only.

nodes.summary: The link (the first child element): data-popup-open while the card is open. Base UI PreviewCard.Trigger.
The floating layer (popover=manual, in the top layer while open), 1u below the link. Base UI PreviewCard.Positioner.
The card: a card-md surface with the reveal motion. Base UI PreviewCard.Popup.
Optional triangle on the card's edge facing the link, centered on it. Base UI PreviewCard.Arrow.
